DISCHARGE paint (line item): rust + caramel acid dye on deep indigo would barely show (acid dye is transparent), so FP01 is DISCHARGE-PAINTED: a discharge paste = non-alkaline discharge agent for wool (Decrolin-type) + ILLUMINATING (discharge-resistant) acid dyes in RUST and CARAMEL, thickened with sodium alginate (Kemtex-type system, technical sheet DP35 'Discharge printing of wool dyed with acid dyes'); the paste strips the indigo and puts the colour in its place. Recipes from the approved lab dips. NOT pigment: no binder, the hand stays soft
Weight / size: ≈ 6–10 g dye powder + ≈ 250 ml paste per set (estimate)
